title: check.ts reuses the shared gitIgnoredEntries walker instead of its private copy
description: LCLI-597 added walkUnignoredMarkdown and a shared gitIgnoredEntries in src/commands/discover.ts, running the same git ls-files query as check.ts private gitIgnoredEntries. It was duplicated only because check.ts was owned by other open work (LCLI-606) at the time. Until check.ts switches to the shared helper, agents-governance discovery and lore check must be changed together, or they disagree about which files exist.

acceptanceCriteria.text: src/commands/check.ts uses the shared helper from src/commands/discover.ts and its private copy is deleted
A test pins that lore check and lore agents discovery skip the same git-ignored files
bun test and bun run lore check exit 0
